comment: Every row of jacks follows one rule: a mono jack overrides its voice, a polyphonic jack drives by channel any voice whose mono jack is empty, and with neither patched the knob stands. The sample jack is a pitch jack in shape but a chooser in effect: it is quantised to semitones and a semitone is one sample on. Sample choice and decay are latched when the voice fires; pitch and level are read every sample. The kits folder is a plugin-wide setting shared with vates, while the chosen kit is per module and saved with the patch by name, so a patch finds its kit again as long as the folder still holds a subfolder of that name. Kits load on a background thread and voices already ringing finish on the old kit. The playback engine is a clean-room reimplementation of the Erica Synths Pico DRUM sample player, built from the published manual with no code from the hardware or any port. The panel prints pellicula, poly, the numbers 1 to 8 over the columns, trig, sample, pitch, decay, level and mix.
